acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given an integration test suite, When the Moodle OAuth2 mock responds with valid roles, Then the user is successfully logged in and granted appropriate archive access.
Given an E2E test, When Moodle is simulated as offline, Then the user can successfully log in using the autonomous fallback mechanism.
Given a UI accessibility scan, When the login page is analyzed, Then zero WCAG 2.1 AA violations are found.
notes: Verified backend integration tests for SSO and fallback, verified E2E coverage for auth UI and fallback flow. Verified UI accessibility using axe-core checking WCAG 2.1 AA rules.
